text:
ana: quick ask — can we run a small throughput matrix for cb tuning on pool-g4dn-x2? need numbers for batch_size x max_tokens to validate the queue-priority patch. target is p95 latency < 120ms for 128 tokens. can someone kick off or point me to an existing run?

mike: I can run a quick sweep tonight. which model + payload distribution? small bursts or steady qps?

ana: prefer steady qps 40rps with 50% short <64 tokens and 50% long 256. model: redwood/tiny-34b-quant. use caching off for this run.

mike: got it. will run with batch_size [4,8,16] and max_tokens [64,128,256]. ETA ~ 2h. will post logs.

lina: pinging @mike please add the `--queue-priority=soft` variant so we can compare. also leave warmup 30s.

ryan: FYI the PR I opened changes queue handoff timing, PR #4728. perf tests there were flaky yesterday. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4728

mike: adding flag. command I'm using:

```bash
./bench/run_throughput.sh --model redwood/tiny-34b-quant \
  --qps 40 --duration 600 \
  --payload-mix short:50,long:50 \
  --batch-sizes 4,8,16 \
  --max-tokens 64,128,256 \
  --queue-priority soft \
  --warmup 30
```

bench-bot: scheduled run 2175001240 on pool-g4dn-x2. will post summary when done.

ana: thanks. also can we capture KV cache hit rates and backend latency breakdown (kernel vs scheduling)? would help isolate where small-batch regression hits.

ryan: I suspect it's scheduling jitter. small-batch path adds ~6ms per request due to preemption. I posted microprofile snippet in PR comments:

```python
# microprofiler output
sched.switch_wait_ms = 5.9
kernel.exec_ms = 18.4
kv.lookup_ms = 2.1
```

lina: if scheduling is culprit, we should test `--batch-timeout` tweak too. please include run with `--batch-timeout 5ms` and `--batch-timeout 10ms`.

mike: ok adding those. that will double the matrix but still quick.

bench-bot: run complete. summary: p95 latency for (batch=4,max=64,timeout=5ms)=142ms, (batch=8,max=128,timeout=10ms)=110ms, cache off. uploading full CSV: https://console.redwood.ai/bench/2175001240/results.csv

ana: ugh 142ms for small batch. can you attach raw latency histogram and cpu/gpu utilization?

bench-bot: attached: CSV + heatmap screenshot: https://console.redwood.ai/bench/2175001240/heatmap.png

ryan: looks like small batches spike during GC-like scheduler ops. gpu util low 45% during spikes.

lina: can we try `--max-batch-queue 64` cap to reduce head-of-queue wait? add as variant.

mike: starting a targeted run for that cap now. ETA 20m.

sre-bot: note: dedicated pool pool-g4dn-x2 currently at 78% capacity. if tests increase load, autoscaler may kick in.

ana: noted, keep me posted. if this cap helps we may default it for low-latency tier.

mike: updated results: with `--max-batch-queue 64`, p95 for small batch went to 118ms, still above target but much better. pushing CSV: https://console.redwood.ai/bench/2175001280/max-queue-64.csv

ana: nice improvement. can we file a follow-up ticket to tune scheduler preemption and run longer stability test? I'll create ticket.

ana: created ticket RUNTIME-998: 'scheduler preemption tuning for cb small-batch latency' — assign to @ryan and @mike. link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/RUNTIME-998

mike: ack. will triage.

ryan: ok will take it. plan: add hysteresis to preemption and a lightweight backoff for small batches.

ana: thanks team :thumbsup:
